Overview.Name: Harika Mandava
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 1: Idli (2) & sambar (1 cup) (simple) & curd (100 g)
Option 2: Egg omelette/bhurji (2 eggs) (pan-cooked) & curd (100 g)
Option 3: Poha (1 medium bowl ~1.5 cups cooked) & peanuts (1 tbsp) & curd (100 g)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & dal (simple) & vegetable curry (1 small bowl)
Option 2: 2 chapati & paneer curry (paneer ~60–80 g) & curd (small cup)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & curd (small cup)
Evening_Snack: Option 3: Puffed rice (murmura) chaat (2 cups) (onion & tomato & lemon & salt)
Meal_3: Option 1: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & 1 chapati
Option 2: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) (pan-cooked) & salad (cucumber/onion) (1 bowl)
Option 3: Curd (small cup) & buttermilk (unsweetened) (200–250 ml) (lightest option)

Notes_and_Tips: For fat loss: keep rice to ~3/4–1 cup cooked (110–150 g) and make dal/paneer/eggs/curd the main to stay full.
Because you lose control once you start eating: serve one fixed plate and wait 10 minutes before taking more.
Stress trigger: drink water first and do 10 slow breaths before meals; avoid starting with fried snacks.
Sweet cravings: keep fruit/curd/buttermilk first; if you want something sweet, plan it after lunch (small portion) instead of late night.
Fried & spicy cravings: use roasted makhana as your crunchy option and add spice to main meals (sambar/veg curry) instead of extra snacks.
Irregular periods support: focus on consistent meal timing and daily protein (dal/paneer/eggs/curd).
